summary: A member brings an agency’s written answer into floor proceedings so others can read its reasoning.
realLife: The House record of July 26, 1966, printed the federal reply to Fountain about hospital compliance and Medicare.
gates: The agency has answered the member in writing.
inGame: needs: dated agency correspondence linked to the member's entry in the floor record.

turns.what: The member enters the agency's answer and requests the missing enclosure.
turns.pulledBy: The reply refers to a policy memorandum that never reached the office.
turns.writesBack: The floor entry identifies the document still outstanding.

turns.what: The member submits a correction when the agency clarifies its answer.
turns.pulledBy: The original reply left the scope of a condition unclear.
turns.writesBack: A later entry links the clarification to the first one.
